newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Energy Resources 1st qtr profit rises.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Energy Resources 1st qtr profit rises.

text.p: Uranium producer Energy Resources of Australia Ltd (ERA) said on Wednesday its first quarter net profit rose to A$600,000 compared to a loss of A$200,000 in the previous corresponding quarter.
"This result was much as anticipated with sales on major contracts being skewed toward the second and fourth quarters of each fiscal year," ERA said.
ERA's sales revenue for the quarter was A$16 million compared to A$7.1 million in the first quarter of 1995.
Sales were achieved from concentrates of 136 tonnes, compared to 41 tonnes, of uranium oxide (U3O8) from its Ranger mine and 270 tonnes compared to 178 tonnes of U3O8 concentrates from third parties.

ERA said its earnings before interest and tax (EBIT) for the quarter rose to A$1.8 million compared to A$0.7 million. The company said the big increase in EBIT was a result of the increase in the sales volume of Ranger concentrates.
Ranger is one of Australia's only two uranium mines.
ERA is 68 percent owned by North Ltd.
